note: Second dev set. One-filter joins, lookups through an intermediate table, top-one, distinct counts and literal dates on values and shapes no training pair uses. Written after the run-5 failure analysis and before the fix was trained and scored.

questions.question: Show the rfd id and the customer name for every refund request for damaged goods.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.rfd_id, c.cust_nm FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE r.reason_cd = 'DMG'
questions.tests: answer exactly the question: no invented filter or column

questions.question: How many customers have at least one refund request for damaged goods?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.cust_id) FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE r.reason_cd = 'DMG'
questions.tests: answer exactly the question: no invented filter or column
